findingClass: a completed prospectus-family extraction yields no issuer ratio and names no cause - the reader stopped being called (or never was) and nothing anywhere said so
failThreshold: any COMPLETED RHP/DRHP/PROSPECTUS document extracted on or after the wiring date whose IPO has no financial_data.current_ratio AND whose E9 step evidence records none of ratio_note_not_in_document / ratio_row_not_in_note / balance_sheet_inputs_absent
unverifiableWhen: no prospectus-family document has completed extraction since the wiring date - the population is empty, which is a statement about the corpus and not about the pipeline
why: scraper/scripts/financial_ratios.py merged in #638 with ZERO importers: correct, unit-tested, and never invoked, so every document produced null ratios in silence. A unit test proves the reader reads; only an audit over real rows proves it is still being CALLED. This is the same class as item 8a's peer locator, which was merged into TypeScript where nothing would ever call it. The check deliberately accepts a RECORDED REASON as a pass, because a document with no ratio note in it is a fact about the document, not a defect - what is never acceptable is an absence with no cause (signal-ownership.md R1: a number is not a reading).
locatorNote: Scoped to documents extracted on or after the wiring date (RATIO_WIRING_MERGED_AT, default 2026-09-16): documents completed before it could not carry a ratio however healthy the pipeline was, so including them would report a permanent FAIL that no night can clear. Their repair is item 8 slice 3b.
